# Explicitly unsupported procedure forms must fail without side effects.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_strict() BEGIN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_strict_true() OPTIONS(strict_mode=TRUE) BEGIN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_system() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE) BEGIN SET @@time_zone = 'Asia/Tokyo'; END;
BEGIN CALL errors_procedures.proc_system(); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE errors_procedures.proc_dynamic_system() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "SET @@time_zone = 'Asia/Tokyo'"; END;
BEGIN CALL errors_procedures.proc_dynamic_system(); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support
